```{r}
# Detect subsurface chlorophyll accumulations that surface measurements miss
detect_subsurface_accumulation <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(date, station) %>%
    filter(pres >= 1, pres <= 50, !is.na(f_npq)) %>%
    arrange(pres) %>%
    filter(n() >= 6, max(pres) >= 8) %>%  # cast has at least 7 depths and max >8m
    summarise(
      # Surface reference (what a buoy/satellite would see)
      surface_chl = mean(f_npq[pres <= 2], na.rm = TRUE),  # give the mean of only <2m
      near_surface_chl = mean(f_npq[pres <= 5], na.rm = TRUE),  # Buoy depth
      
      # Subsurface characteristics
      subsurface_max = max(f_npq[pres > 2], na.rm = TRUE),  # Below surface measurement
      subsurface_max_depth = pres[pres > 2][which.max(f_npq[pres > 2])], #finds max flu below 2m depth
      
      # Integrated characteristics (key for biomass assessment)
      integrated_chl = sum(f_npq[pres <= 50] * c(diff(pres[pres <= 50])[1],
                                                 diff(pres[pres <= 50])),
                           na.rm = TRUE),  # Rough integration
      surface_integrated = sum(f_npq[pres <= 5] * diff(pres)[1], na.rm = TRUE),  # Surface layer only
      subsurface_integrated = integrated_chl - surface_integrated,  # Below surface layer
      
      # Profile characteristics
      max_chl_overall = max(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE), #profile max chl
      max_depth_overall = pres[which.max(f_npq)], #profile max depth
      profile_mean = mean(f_npq[pres <= 50], na.rm = TRUE), #profile mean chl
      
      # Biomass distribution metrics
      subsurface_integrated_fraction = subsurface_integrated / integrated_chl,  # Fraction below 5m
      surface_fraction = surface_integrated / integrated_chl,
      surface_representation = surface_chl / profile_mean,  # How well surface represents profile
      
      month = month(first(date)),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      # Calculate enhancement ratios
      subsurface_max_surface_ratio = subsurface_max / surface_chl,
      subsurface_max_near_surface_ratio = subsurface_max / near_surface_chl,
      
      # Key criteria for subsurface accumulation
      has_subsurface_accumulation = case_when(
        # High biomass cases where surface misses significant chlorophyll
        subsurface_max > 5.0 &  # Substantial chlorophyll maximum
        (subsurface_max_surface_ratio > 1.5 | subsurface_max_near_surface_ratio > 1.5) &  # Surface underestimates
        subsurface_integrated_fraction > 0.4 &  # Significant subsurface biomass
        subsurface_max_depth > 5 ~ TRUE,  # Clearly subsurface
        
        # Moderate biomass but strong subsurface signal
        subsurface_max > 2.0 &
        subsurface_max_surface_ratio > 2.0 &
        subsurface_integrated_fraction > 0.5 &
        surface_representation < 0.7 ~ TRUE,  # Surface poorly represents profile
        
        # Lower biomass but very strong subsurface concentration
        subsurface_max_surface_ratio > 3.0 &
        subsurface_integrated_fraction > 0.6 &
        subsurface_max_depth > 3 ~ TRUE,
        
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      ),
      
  # Classify type of subsurface accumulation
      accumulation_type = case_when(
        !has_subsurface_accumulation & integrated_chl > 100 ~ "surface_bloom",
        !has_subsurface_accumulation ~ "no bloom",
        subsurface_max > 10 ~ "high_biomass_scm",
        subsurface_max > 5 ~ "moderate_biomass_scm", 
        subsurface_max_surface_ratio > 3 ~ "low_biomass_scm", #was strong_subsurface, but changed to low biomass as SCM present, but at low concentrations
        TRUE ~ "weak_subsurface"
      ),
      
      # Estimate how much surface measurements underestimate
      subsurface_max_surface_perc_change = (subsurface_max - surface_chl) / subsurface_max,
      subsurface_max_near_surface_perc_change = (subsurface_max - near_surface_chl) / subsurface_max,
      
      # Depth characteristics
      subsurface_max_depth = ifelse(has_subsurface_accumulation, subsurface_max_depth, NA)
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      season = case_when(
        month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
        month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring", 
        month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
        month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
      )) %>% 
    
    select(date,
           station,
           season,
           has_subsurface_accumulation,
           accumulation_type, 
           subsurface_max_depth,
           subsurface_max,
           surface_chl,
           near_surface_chl,
           subsurface_max_surface_ratio,
           subsurface_max_near_surface_ratio,
           subsurface_max_surface_perc_change,
           subsurface_max_near_surface_perc_change,
           integrated_chl,
           surface_integrated,
           subsurface_integrated, 
           subsurface_integrated_fraction,
           month)
}

# Enhanced debug function for subsurface accumulations
debug_subsurface_accumulation <- function(data, target_date = NULL, target_station = NULL) {
  result <- detect_subsurface_accumulation(data)
  
  if (!is.null(target_date) && !is.null(target_station)) {
    target_result <- result %>% 
      filter(date == target_date, station == target_station)
    
    profile_data <- data %>%
      filter(date == target_date, station == target_station) %>%
      arrange(pres)
    
    if (nrow(target_result) > 0 && nrow(profile_data) > 0) {
      cat("=== SUBSURFACE ACCUMULATION ANALYSIS ===\n")
      cat("Station:", target_station, "Date:", target_date, "\n\n")
      
      cat("DETECTION RESULT:", target_result$has_subsurface_accumulation, "\n")
      cat("Type:", target_result$accumulation_type, "\n")
      cat("Depth:", target_result$subsurface_max_depth, "m\n\n")
      
      cat("BIOMASS METRICS:\n")
      cat("Surface chl (0-2m):", round(target_result$surface_chl, 2), "\n")
      cat("Near-surface chl (0-5m):", round(target_result$near_surface_chl, 2), "\n")
      cat("Subsurface maximum:", round(target_result$subsurface_max, 2), "\n")
      cat("Integrated chl:", round(target_result$integrated_chl, 2), "\n\n")
      
      cat("SURFACE MISS ANALYSIS:\n")
      cat("Surface underestimation <2m:", round(target_result$subsurface_max_surface_ratio * 100, 1), "%\n")
      cat("Surface underestimation <5m:", round(target_result$subsurface_max_near_surface_ratio * 100, 1), "%\n")
      cat("Subsurface biomass fraction:", round(target_result$subsurface_integrated_fraction * 100, 1), "%\n\n")
      
      cat("ENHANCEMENT RATIOS:\n")
      cat("vs <2m:", round(target_result$subsurface_max_surface_ratio, 2), "x\n")
      cat("vs <5m:", round(target_result$subsurface_max_near_surface_ratio, 2), "x\n\n")
      
      cat("PROFILE SUMMARY:\n")
      cat("Depth range:", min(profile_data$pres), "-", max(profile_data$pres), "m\n")
      cat("Chl range:", round(min(profile_data$f_npq, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "-", 
          round(max(profile_data$f_npq, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
      
      # Show depth distribution
      depth_bins <- cut(profile_data$pres, breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 20, 50), 
                       labels = c("0-5m", "5-10m", "10-20m", "20-50m"))
      depth_summary <- profile_data %>% 
        mutate(depth_bin = depth_bins) %>%
        group_by(depth_bin) %>%
        summarise(mean_chl = mean(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
        filter(!is.na(depth_bin))
      
      cat("Depth distribution:\n")
      for(i in 1:nrow(depth_summary)) {
        cat(" ", depth_summary$depth_bin[i], ":", round(depth_summary$mean_chl[i], 2), "\n")
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Summary function to characterize all subsurface accumulations
summarize_subsurface_events <- function(detection_results) {
  detection_results %>%
    # filter(has_subsurface_accumulation) %>% #Probably worth turning this of as useful to see when not present?
    mutate(
      season = case_when(
        month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
        month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring", 
        month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
        month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(accumulation_type, season) %>% #Add station here if not including 
    summarise(
      count = n(),
      mean_depth = round(mean(subsurface_max_depth, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      mean_max_chl = round(mean(subsurface_max, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      mean_surface_miss = round(mean(subsurface_max_surface_ratio * 100, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      mean_integrated = round(mean(integrated_chl, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      mean_surface_integrated = round(mean(surface_integrated, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_max_chl))
}
```

```{r}
# Example usage:
subsurface_results <- detect_subsurface_accumulation(f)
debug_example <- debug_subsurface_accumulation(f, "2021-06-05", "KC10")
event_summary <- summarize_subsurface_events(subsurface_results)
```

```{r}
# Convert wind direction from degrees to radians
w$wd_rad <- w$wd_dm * pi / 180

# Calculate u and v components
w$u_component <- w$w_dm * sin(w$wd_rad)  # eastward component
w$v_component <- w$w_dm * cos(w$wd_rad)  # northward component

w <- w %>% 
  select(-...1)

e1 <- e %>% 
  filter(pres == 1) %>% 
  select(-...1)


scm_driver <- subsurface_results %>% 
  left_join(w) %>% 
  left_join(e1)


```


```{r}
scm_driver %>%
  filter(month == 5) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(accumulation_type), y = v_component)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(aes(fill = as.factor(year)), pch = 21, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "H") +
  facet_wrap(~season)
```
